primary.title: Securing AI agent identity with X.509 PKI on AWS
primary.summary: Learn how to secure multi-agent AI systems with cryptographic identity using Keyfactor EJBCA and AWS services. This reference architecture combines signed request envelopes, user-signed delegation assertions, RFC 8693 audience-scoped tokens, and real-time OCSP revocation to prove agent identity and prevent request forgery across agent-to-agent and MCP tool calls.

primary.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran
primary.summary: OpenAI improved its latest models for low-resource programming languages like COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic. On the new MultiLangBench, GPT-6 Astra hits an 87.4 percent test pass rate across 20 languages, up from about 38 percent for GPT-5.6 Terra. For COBOL migration specifically, GPT-6.1 Sol reaches up to 97.9 percent accuracy, a result that could matter for modernizing critical financial infrastructure. The article OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran appeared first on The Decoder.
